# Reitumetse Sethabela (Allen Reiley) - Portfolio & Systems Dossier

> Full-Stack Developer, Founder of AuraWorks (Pty) Ltd, and Author of "The Ecommerce Startup That Sells". Specializing in Next.js 16, React 19, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and AI-assisted software engineering.

## Core Engineering Capabilities
- Frontend: Next.js 15/16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion, Lucide
- Backend & Services: FastAPI (Python), Node.js, RESTful Architecture, High-Concurrency APIs
- Data Architecture: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Relational Modeling, Migrations, Indexing
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Railway Cloud, Vercel, Git CI/CD, Containerization
- Methodology: AI-assisted engineering workflows (Antigravity CLI, Cursor, Claude Code) combined with frontline sales psychology

## Commercial Production Systems
- Nubifurn Storefront: Bespoke e-commerce showroom for luxury handcrafted furniture.
  - Live URL: https://nubifurn-frontend.vercel.app/
  - Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Railway, Vercel
  - Case Study: https://reitumetse.dev/projects/nubifurn-frontend
- Nubifurn Operations Dashboard: Internal logistics, product catalog, inventory states, and inquiry pipeline engine.
  - Live Demo: https://nubifurn.vercel.app/
  - Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Railway Cloud
  - Case Study: https://reitumetse.dev/projects/nubifurn-dashboard
- AuraWorks Platform: B2B intelligence, technical infrastructure, and systems platform for AuraWorks (Pty) Ltd.
  - Live URL: https://www.auraworks.co.za/
  - Stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Railway
  - Case Study: https://reitumetse.dev/projects/auraworks
- FLP Church Platform: Community outreach, event scheduling, and dynamic media streaming.
  - Live URL: https://flp-woad.vercel.app/
  - Stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
  - Case Study: https://reitumetse.dev/projects/flp-church
- Tilulu Non-Profit Portal: Transparent donor engagement and mission impact tracking platform.
  - Live URL: https://tilulu.vercel.app/
  - Stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
  - Case Study: https://reitumetse.dev/projects/tilulu
